Hawaii Vacation Packing List
==========================

Based on your itinerary for June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe recommended for Hawaii)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera (with waterproof case for snorkeling)
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- After-sun lotion/aloë vera
- Power adapter/chargers
- Small backpack for day trips

Special Activity Items:
- Formal attire (for the Luau on June 16)
- Spa-appropriate clothing (for June 17 relaxation day)
- Shopping budget/envelope (for Ala Moana Center on June 19)
